0022600015.text: The Washington Wizards (2-3, 9th in the East and 3rd in the Southeast, 1 game back) host the Charlotte Hornets (3-2, 1st in the Southeast, 6th in the East) in the Wizards' sixth game of the 2026-27 season, and Washington has lost its last two. Washington trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after the Wizards lost 110-103 in Charlotte on October 26, and the Wizards lost the 2025-26 series 0-4. Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Tre Johnson (Achilles soreness) is day-to-day and a game-time decision; Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery).
